pnl.name: Commodities – F&B
pnl.root_cause_rev: Q1 FY26-27 net revenue BDT 3.09 Cr against a BDT 7.25 Cr budget — a shortfall of BDT 4.16 Cr (43% achievement): Jul 1.465 vs 1.62 (90%), Aug 0.543 vs 1.66 (33%), Sep 1.085 vs 3.97 (27%). The deficit is supply-driven, not demand-driven. The Malaysia and Thailand import lines that carry the core range were not opened in the quarter, so 56% of finished-goods SKUs (82 of 146) sat at zero stock and three new categories budgeted at BDT 1.64 Cr never traded. A customs branch lock on one Thailand shipment held ~BDT 2.18 Cr of sellable stock for most of July, and a C&F transition that was not F&B-ready produced clearance delays and misdeclared HS codes on 3 of 18 lines. Sell-in was further constrained by credit holds on the two customers who represent ~78% of revenue. Demand was intact — July hit 90% of budget and collections ran at 81% — the business simply had nothing to sell.
pnl.root_cause_loss: PAT −BDT 1.49 Cr against a budgeted profit of BDT 0.30 Cr — adverse BDT 1.79 Cr (Jul −0.357, Aug −0.866, Sep −0.264); EBITDA −1.09 Cr against +1.01 Cr budget. Most of the loss is non-recurring import shock: BDT 87L exceptional cost (BDT 37L demurrage and penalties on a held shipment, BDT 50L from a C&F assessment error that raised Gatorade from USD 1.50 to 7.92) plus a BDT 38.83L NRV write-down. The remainder is structural: volume at 43% of plan cannot absorb fixed cost — August COGS exceeded revenue — gross margin was negative to thin in July–August and only recovered in September.
pnl.plan_rev: Rebuild the range, then hold a steady BDT 2.50 Cr monthly run-rate. Supply is anchored on the approved 5-LC import plan of BDT 10.82 Cr landed (24,185 cartons, 157 SKUs), which carries 17.97% gross margin and 4.19% net margin and is already in execution under CEO approval. Alongside that, widen the channel so the run-rate is not dependent on two accounts: Modern Trade, HORECA, Akij Essential retail, sole distributorship of high-demand lines and demand-led local purchase. Target state: BDT 2.50 Cr/month sustained from November, ~95% availability on the top-20 SKUs, 60%+ of 69 accounts active against 14 today, top-2 customer concentration below 50%, blended GP 18%, and monthly PAT positive. FY27 revenue lands at ~BDT 24.70 Cr against the BDT 36.61 Cr ABP, which is re-baselined with the Board rather than left as an unachievable number.
pnl.plan_loss: Separate recurring trading margin from exceptional import cost, then price every SKU off true landed cost so a BDT 2.50 Cr run-rate produces a positive bottom line. At the approved import plan's 17.97% GP and 4.19% NP, BDT 2.50 Cr/month yields roughly BDT 0.10 Cr PAT per month. Target state: blended GP 18%, monthly PAT breakeven from November-26, Q3 and Q4 each contributing ~BDT 0.30 Cr, FY27 loss contained to ≤BDT 0.90 Cr against a −5.96 Cr annualized Q1 run-rate, DIO cut from 59 to 45 days, and the BDT 1.49 Cr Q1 loss recovered through trading margin and cost, not one-off gains.

The margin is being diluted. Customer discounts are given to compete, high-margin categories are a small share of sales, and supplier terms for trade discounts and bonuses are weak. 4. Cut working-capital and finance costs. Target state: 1. GP rises to about 13% by December and to 14% or more by June 2027. 2. Opex as a share of sales falls from about 23% to about 14%. 3. Q2 loss falls to 1.6 Cr or less. 4. Monthly EAT breaks even by June 2027.

Root causes: (1) gross-margin collapse — GP% 96.8% (Jul) → 43.7% (Aug) → 1.5% (Sep); Q1 blended 36.7%; Sep's ~1.5% GP on 0.29 Cr revenue is the driver as mix shifted to low/zero-margin LinkedIn resale + one-off training while the high-margin payroll/staffing pillar was still ramping; (2) marketing overspend — Q1 ~BDT 16.19M vs ~10.11M budget (160%), S&M ~3.8× revenue; (3) broken unit economics — CAC ≈ ৳126,400 vs LTV ≈ ৳29,900 (LTV:CAC 0.24 vs 11.67× plan); (4) fixed cost base built ahead of revenue, with 9 of 14 streams inactive and the 68.3% pillar producing ~BDT 0 until Aug.

(1) Scale Payroll/Staffing/RPO (68.3% pillar) on 3 models — % of payroll disbursement (4–10%), per-head ৳600–1,200, prepaid per-position ৳500–700 (Model 3) — to ≥৳9.5L/mo (stretch ৳15L). (2) Rebuild Training (corporate + public + government) to ≥৳13L/mo. (3) Monetize the 7,343 employer accounts (636 verified → 1,000+) to ≥৳4L/mo and 300 paid posts/mo. (4) Activate ≥6 of 9 inactive streams (CV, BGV, Salary Survey, Employer Branding, Assessment, CV Bank, International, RMS/ATS, Premium) with first revenue. Target by Dec-26: 20–30L/mo exit run-rate, LTV:CAC 0.24 → ≥0.45, employer retention 18% → 40%, staffing-led high-GP mix.

(2) Repair margin: shift mix to staffing (VAT on fee-only), pricing lock, commission redesign (2× staffing/posting/CV/BGV, 0.5× LinkedIn resale), cap LinkedIn ≤15% of mix. (3) Discipline spend: freeze paid jobseeker acquisition while LTV:CAC <1; tier-gated marketing. Target state: EAT loss ≤ budget and trending to breakeven; GP% restored toward 60%+; LTV:CAC ≥0.45 by Dec (path ≥1 by Jun-27).
